title: Giving Examples
answer_framework:
Abstract ideas in Part 3 can be difficult to explain clearly. The best way to make your point understood and to extend your answer naturally is to provide a concrete example. Use the 'General to Specific' framework.

1. State the General Truth: 'Many young people struggle with financial literacy.'
2. Introduce the Example: Use a strong phrase like 'A prime example of this is...' or 'To illustrate this point...'
3. Give a Specific Real-World Scenario: '...how many university graduates take out massive credit card debt because they were never taught budgeting in high school.'
useful_phrase_bank: A prime example of this is ...
For instance, we only need to look at ...

weak_vs_better.weak_answer: Pollution is bad. Like in my city, it's dirty.
weak_vs_better.better_answer: Air pollution has severe consequences for public health. A prime example of this is the rising rate of respiratory issues, such as asthma, in heavily industrialized cities.

fluency_pronunciation_note: Pause very briefly before and after your example marker (e.g., [Pause] 'To illustrate this point,' [Pause] 'many graduates...'). This chunking helps the listener process the transition from theory to reality.
sample_ielts_question: How has technology changed the way we communicate?
model_short_answer: Technology has made communication instantaneous but perhaps less personal. To illustrate this point, we only need to look at how people behave in restaurants nowadays. Families will sit together at a table, but instead of talking to each other, everyone is glued to their smartphone screens.
common_mistakes: Using 'For example' in every single sentence.
Giving highly personal examples in Part 3 (e.g., 'For example, my uncle John...') instead of societal examples.
Giving an example that doesn't actually match the reason previously stated.
image_prompt_fallback: A teacher pointing to a specific chart on a projector screen, illustrating a real-world data point to a class.

quiz.question: Which of the following is the most appropriate type of example for Part 3?

options.A: My sister bought a new car yesterday.
options.B: For example, I really like eating pizza on Fridays.
options.C: A prime example of this is how major corporations use targeted social media advertising.
options.D: I think it is very good for everyone.

quiz.explanation: Part 3 is an academic, societal discussion. Option C provides a broad, societal/business example ('major corporations'), whereas A and B are too personal and better suited for Part 1 or 2.
